name: jev-router
originalDescription: 让 Jev 在几个候选模型里挑，把 Claude Code 的任务交给最便宜、又够用的模型。
description: Route Claude Code tasks to a suitable lower-cost model from a defined set of candidates.

name: jev-agent-skill-router
originalDescription: 让 Jev 替 Agent 挑技能，匹配度低就不选，不硬凑。
description: Choose a skill for an agent, with explicit no-skill and review paths when the match is uncertain.

name: jcm-router
originalDescription: 本地代理：每条消息由 Jev 决定用哪个 Claude 模型、开多大推理强度。
description: A local proxy that selects a Claude model and reasoning effort for each message.

name: jev-router · prismhq
originalDescription: 基于 LiteLLM 的开源路由器，每个请求由 Jev 决定交给哪个模型。
description: A LiteLLM-based router that uses Jev to choose a model for each request.

name: fx
originalDescription: Vercel Labs 的编程 Agent，内置的权限审查交给 Jev，而不是再调一次大模型。
description: A coding agent from Vercel Labs that uses Jev for permission-review decisions.

name: jev-axi
originalDescription: Claude Code / Codex 执行命令前的关卡：给每条 shell 命令打「破坏性、外传数据、远程执行、削弱安全」的分，项目自报 44 条标注样例全对。
description: Assess shell commands for destructive actions, data transfer, remote execution and weakened security before an agent acts.

name: jev-guard
originalDescription: 给 Claude Code、Codex 等 Agent 挡提示词注入和危险操作，由 Jev 决定拦不拦。
description: A guard layer for coding agents that evaluates prompt injection and potentially dangerous operations.

name: is-malicious
originalDescription: 装依赖前让 Jev 逐个检查源码和构建文件，可疑的再细查，指出有问题的文件和行。
description: Inspect dependency source and build files, then examine suspicious files and lines more closely.

name: pi-heed
originalDescription: Agent 每次要动手改东西前，检查这一步是不是用户真的要求的。
description: Check whether an agent’s next action actually follows the user’s request.

name: jev-git
originalDescription: git 提交和推送前一秒内扫一遍改动，看有没有密钥和破坏性命令。
description: Scan changes for secrets and destructive commands before a Git commit or push.

name: Abide
originalDescription: 盯着编程 Agent 的每次改动，用 Jev 标出违反规则的地方；项目自报标出的 39 处改动里，独立复核确认 10 处。
description: Watch coding-agent changes and flag potential violations of project rules for review.

name: Clean Code Judge
originalDescription: 给 PR 里每个文件查 31 个「代码坏味道」是非题，结果交给写作模型写审查意见。
description: Evaluate pull-request files against 31 code-quality questions, then pass findings to a writing model.

name: DiffJury
originalDescription: 按风险给每个 PR 分流，再决定派哪位审查者。
description: Triage pull requests by risk and decide which reviewer should handle them.

name: limpet
originalDescription: 防止 Agent 活没干完就说「做好了」：用 Jev 判断完成条件是否满足。
description: Check completion criteria before an agent announces that a task is finished.

name: Hunch
originalDescription: 用大白话写代码规范，由 Jev 逐条检查代码，本地或每个 PR 都能跑。
description: Write coding rules in plain language and check them locally or on pull requests.

name: Browserbase + Jev
originalDescription: Jev 加 Stagehand：把网页结构当材料、能做的操作当选项，Jev 选下一步；帖子说一次任务 0.001 美元。
description: Kyle Jeong’s browser-agent demonstration: Jev chooses an action; Stagehand carries it out.

name: jev-ultrafast
originalDescription: browser-use 出品的超快浏览器 Agent：下一步点哪里由 Jev 决定，只有需要打字时才调用大模型。
description: A browser-use agent that lets Jev select the next action and uses a generative model when text is needed.

name: Jev Browser
originalDescription: 每一步都由 Jev 决定的浏览器自动化，主打比大模型驱动快得多、便宜得多。
description: A browser-automation project built around Jev decisions at each step.

name: unclutter
originalDescription: 浏览器插件：Jev 判断页面上哪些元素是干扰，自动清掉。
description: A browser extension that identifies distracting page elements and removes them.

name: typesafe-adblock
originalDescription: Chrome 插件：逐个问 Jev「这个网页元素是不是广告」，把去广告变成一连串是非题。
description: A Chrome extension that turns ad detection into a series of yes-or-no judgments.

name: public-browser
originalDescription: 让 Claude Code、Cursor 操控真实的 Chrome，动作由 Jev 决定，项目自报 token 少约 30%、成本低约 25%。
description: Let coding agents operate a real Chrome browser, with Jev helping choose actions.

name: Sniff Test
originalDescription: 写作检查器：每段问 Jev 10 个是非题（堆叠的含糊词、重复的收尾句、「不是 X 而是 Y」句式等），门槛 0.7，项目自报中位耗时 182 毫秒。
description: Check paragraphs for vague phrasing, repetitive endings and other writing patterns using focused judgments.

name: pagegrade
originalDescription: 给网页的每一节打清晰度、文字质量和 SEO 分。
description: Evaluate sections of a web page for clarity, writing quality and SEO.

name: JevSlop
originalDescription: 在一次请求里给 note.com 文章打 8 个维度的分，再算成 0 到 100 的「水文分」。
description: Evaluate note.com articles across eight dimensions and combine them into a content-quality score.

name: citation-verifier
originalDescription: 查论文引用：Claude 找到被引的原句，Jev 判断支不支持，最后由人拍板。
description: Use Claude to locate cited passages and Jev to assess support, with a person making the final call.

name: Email triage · Ryan Vogel
originalDescription: 拿自己的 1500 封真实邮件测试，每封判类别、优先级、是否垃圾邮件、要不要回复；视频里 8 个并发、平均每封 193 毫秒。
description: A demonstration of categorizing email, judging priority, detecting spam and deciding whether a reply is needed.

name: Notra
originalDescription: 营销分析平台：把品牌曝光的分类判断从大模型搬到 Jev，是非题门槛 0.5，目标中位耗时 300 毫秒。
description: A marketing-analytics platform exploring Jev for brand-visibility classification.

name: Email intent routing
originalDescription: 每封来信用一个 Choice 判断是发票还是普通邮件，交给对应的处理流程。
description: Classify incoming messages as invoices or general email and send them to the corresponding workflow.

name: jev-curate
originalDescription: 用 Jev 的是非题和置信度筛选合成数据集，合格的和被拒的分别写到磁盘。
description: Filter synthetic datasets using condition judgments and confidence, saving accepted and rejected records separately.

name: CV screener
originalDescription: 按一份可修改的标准筛一整个文件夹的简历；标准改了，重新打分不用额外花钱。
description: A resume-screening experiment with editable criteria and reusable scores. Human review remains essential.

name: typeful-triage
originalDescription: 开源项目 issue 分拣面板：每个 issue 问类型、严重程度、紧急程度、是否重复、下一步做什么，人工改过的都记下来。
description: An issue-triage dashboard covering type, severity, urgency, duplicates and next steps, with recorded human corrections.

name: fast-jev-compaction
originalDescription: Claude Code 插件：上下文快满时，不做总结，而是让 Jev 逐条判断哪些工具调用和结果还用得上，原文保留。
description: Keep useful tool calls and results in a coding session while removing irrelevant context without summarizing it.

name: yoshi
originalDescription: Claude Code 和 Codex 的代理层：先让 Jev 判断哪些历史对话还需要，再删掉不需要的。
description: A proxy layer for Claude Code and Codex that evaluates which conversation history is still needed.

name: wakegate
originalDescription: 定时唤醒休眠的 Agent 之前，先问 Jev 该不该醒，没必要就不叫醒大模型。
description: Check whether a scheduled agent wake-up is necessary before waking a larger model.

name: Jev Trader · Jarrod Watts
originalDescription: 每个 300 毫秒的区块判断买还是卖，在 Monad 链上的订单簿下单；演示视频里标着 dry run（模拟运行）。
description: A block-by-block trading experiment. The shared demonstration shows dry-run mode; it is not evidence of profitability.

name: HA-Jev
originalDescription: Home Assistant 智能家居插件：关于家里状况的问题，用概率、选项或分数来回答。
description: A Home Assistant integration that answers questions about home state with choices, scores and probabilities.

name: jevinci
originalDescription: 让 Jev 并行猜出每个像素的颜色来画画，把握越大，笔触越宽。
description: An experimental painter that selects pixel colors in parallel and uses confidence to vary brush width.

name: pacman-jev
originalDescription: 吃豆人：让 Jev 决定每一步往哪走的开源实现。
description: An open-source Pac-Man experiment where Jev chooses which direction to move next.

name: tetris-ai
originalDescription: 浏览器俄罗斯方块，可以让内置规划程序、Jev 或任何聊天模型来玩。
description: Browser Tetris playable by a built-in planner, Jev or a chat model.

name: Jev Pong
originalDescription: 乒乓球游戏，球每走一步由模型决定一次，让 Jev 和大模型正面对打。
description: A Pong experiment comparing model-controlled decisions as the ball moves.

name: robo-harness
originalDescription: 机械臂工作台：Jev 在候选动作里挑下一步关节怎么动，还有花费上限。
description: A robotic-arm workbench that selects joint actions from candidates and includes a spending limit.

name: jevcal
originalDescription: 用你自己的标注数据，为每个问题拟合达到目标准确率的置信度门槛，还能算出多少请求仍要交给大模型；模型更新让门槛失效时，自动检查会报错。
description: Fit confidence thresholds to labeled examples and estimate fallback rates, with checks for model changes.

name: When reranking does not help
originalDescription: 一次实测：33,047 条目录、164 个真实查询，结论是单靠 Jev 重排序没有胜过向量检索。
description: A reported test of 33,047 entries and 164 queries where Jev-only reranking did not outperform vector retrieval.

name: NanoJev
originalDescription: 0.6B 参数的开源仿制版：直接输出完整概率分布，附训练流程、权重和数据集。
description: An independent 0.6B-parameter decision-model implementation with training code, weights and data.

name: Laya
originalDescription: 开源的非逐字生成判断模型，一次前向约 35 毫秒回答三种题型。
description: An independent non-autoregressive decision-model project supporting three question types.

name: kev
originalDescription: 在 Qwen2.5-0.5B 上做的迷你版，能在 MacBook 上训练和运行。
description: A small independent decision-model experiment based on Qwen2.5-0.5B, designed to train and run on a MacBook.
